```{r}
# ============================================================
# Title:    Statistical Model Diagnostics and Post-hoc Analysis Script

# Description:
# This script uses model diagnostic libraries to check the model fit,
# post-hoc analysis for Position P1 an P2.
#
# Note:
# In this file, following shorthand notations are used:
#       - Base: Confirmatory Model
#       - Exp: Exploratory Model
#       - SO1 - Spillover 1
#       - SO2 - Spillover 2
# ============================================================
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. Model fit and residual analysis
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# Residual calculation and plots using: https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/DHARMa/versions/0.4.7/topics/simulateResiduals
run_residual_diagnostics <- function(model, model_name) {
    # Simulate
    model_sim <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model, n = 1000)
    # Plot
    png(file.path(plot_path, paste0(model_name, "_res.png")), width = 800, height = 600) # Save as PNG
    plot(model_sim)
    dev.off()

    # Extract the test results
    uniform_test <- testUniformity(model_sim)
    dispersion_test <- testDispersion(model_sim)
    inflation_test <- tryCatch(
        {
            testZeroInflation(model_sim)
        },
        error = function(e) {
            print("Zero Inflation not applicable for this model")
            NA
        }
    )

    data.frame(
        model_name = model_name,
        n_obs = nobs(model),
        uniformity_p = uniform_test$p.value,
        dispersion_p = dispersion_test$p.value,
        zero_inflation_p = if (is.na(inflation_test)[1]) NA else inflation_test$p.value,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
}
```
```{r}
# P1 Models
p1_roi_base_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p1_roi_base_model, "P1_ROI_Confirmatory")
p1_roi_exp_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p1_roi_exp_model, "P1_ROI_Exploratory")
p1_so1_base_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p1_so1_base_model, "P1_SO1_Confirmatory")
p1_so1_exp_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p1_so1_exp_model, "P1_SO1_Exploratory")
p1_so2_base_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p1_so2_base_model, "P1_SO2_Confirmatory")
p1_so2_exp_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p1_so2_exp_model, "P1_SO2_Exploratory")
```
```{r}
# P2 Models
p2_roi_base_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p2_roi_base_model, "P2_ROI_Confirmatory")
p2_roi_exp_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p2_roi_exp_model, "P2_ROI_Exploratory")
p2_so1_base_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p2_so1_base_model, "P2_SO1_Confirmatory")
p2_so1_exp_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p2_so1_exp_model, "P2_SO1_Exploratory")
p2_so2_base_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p2_so2_base_model, "P2_SO2_Confirmatory")
p2_so2_exp_results <- run_residual_diagnostics(p2_so2_exp_model, "P2_SO2_Exploratory")
```
```{r}
# Combine all model results
full_diagnostics <- rbind(
    p1_roi_base_results,
    p1_roi_exp_results,
    p1_so1_base_results,
    p1_so1_exp_results,
    p1_so2_base_results,
    p1_so2_exp_results,
    p2_roi_base_results,
    p2_roi_exp_results,
    p2_so1_base_results,
    p2_so1_exp_results,
    p2_so2_base_results,
    p2_so2_exp_results
)

full_diagnostics <- full_diagnostics %>%
    mutate(
        model_name = gsub("SO", "Spillover", model_name)
    ) %>%
    mutate(model_name = gsub("_", " ", model_name))

print(full_diagnostics)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2. Checking the fixed effects and CI for Position P1
# ============================================================

# Mean of IH > Mean of C1 but the significance is not reached. So check the effect size
# First check the effect size, fixed effects estimations and CI checks
```

```{r}
# Base Model at P1 ROI
emm_p1_roi_base <- emmeans(p1_roi_base_model, ~WordTypeP1) # Type is added to obtain the raw RT CI
p1_roi_base_contrasts <- contrast(emm_p1_roi_base, method = "revpairwise")


# Plot this
emm_p1_roi_base_df <- as.data.frame(emm_p1_roi_base)
p1_roi_base_eff_ci <- ggplot(emm_p1_roi_base_df, aes(x = WordTypeP1, y = emmean)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.2) +
    ylab("Predicted Log Reading Time") +
    xlab("P1 Word Types (Confirmatory Model)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_path, "p1_roi_base_eff_ci.png"), plot = p1_roi_base_eff_ci, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Random effects for participants at ROI base model
p1_roi_base_ranef_users_df <- subset(p1_roi_base_ranef_df, grpvar == "user_id" & term == "WordTypeP11")
ggplot(p1_roi_base_ranef_users_df, aes(x = condval)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, fill = "#FEDA8B", color = "black") +
    xlab("Participant deviation from mean IH effect (P1 ROI)") +
    ylab("Number of participants") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    ggtitle("Distribution of IH effect across participants at ROI (Confirmatory Model)")
```
